# Statuses

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.ts from src/content. Don't edit: run `npm run docs:tables`. -->

Every status effect. **Turns** is the default duration.

| Status | Kind | Turns | Stat changes | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Scorched (`scorched`) | bad | 3 | — | Lose 6% of max Heart per turn. |
| Shredded (`shredded`) | bad | 3 | -40% Grit | Grit −40%. |
| The Blues (`blues`) | bad | 3 | -30% Chops | Chops −30%. |
| Off-Beat (`offbeat`) | bad | 2 | — | 50% chance to lose the turn (bosses: 25%). |
| Swooned (`swooned`) | bad | 1 | — | Skip the next turn. Bosses are immune. |
| Muted (`muted`) | bad | 2 | — | Can't PLAY or SOLO. |
| Rattled (`rattled`) | bad | 3 | -40% Tempo | Tempo −40%. |
| Hyped (`hyped`) | good | 3 | +30% Chops | Chops +30%. |
| Foundation (`foundation`) | good | 3 | +40% Grit | Grit +40%. |
| Up-Tempo (`uptempo`) | good | 3 | +40% Tempo | Tempo +40%. |
| In the Pocket (`pocket`) | good | 3 | — | +25% crit chance and a wider ONE zone. |
| Encore (`encore`) | good | 3 | — | Regain 8% of max Heart per turn. |
| Countermelody (`countermelody`) | good | until triggered | — | The next attack on you deals 30% less, and you counter with HOT ×1.5. |
| Pitch Shield (`pitchshield`) | good | until triggered | — | The next 3 hits deal 25% unless one lands ON THE ONE or is a SOLO, which shatters it. |
| Perfect Silence (`silence`) | good | until triggered | — | Takes no damage. Only Playing the Blues can shatter it. |
| Quantized (`quantized`) | bad | 2 | — | The ONE zone is narrowed. |
| Charging (`charging`) | good | 1 | — | Winding up for something big. VAMP to brace. |
